senses.gloss: asparagus, also shoots of cabbage, like asparagus in form.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:10">Ned. VI, 10</cite> if one vows abstinence from cabbage <he>אסור בא׳</he> he is forbidden to eat asparagus (the latter being considered a species of the genus ‘cabbage’).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 4:5">Tosef. Dem. IV, 5</cite> <he>לקנב את הא׳ שׁבו</he> to cut off the stalks thereon (and throw the remainder away).

senses.gloss: asparagus, a beverage of wine or beer with asparagus.
units: Kidd. 70ᵃ אי׳ דקריוה וכ׳ aspar. as the educated call (the morning drink). [Yalk. Gen. 34 איספרגוס read אִיסְפַרְגִּיס (σφραγίς) seal, v. סְפַרְגִּיס.]
